note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated customs records, not by website claims: 5 visible rows dated 2026-02-10, exporter VANESA COSMETICS PRIVATE LIMITED (address 4, RAM CHANDER LANE CIVIL LINES), port of loading TUGLAKABAD ICD INTKD6 (India), destination Dakar, Senegal, buyer BATHIE KHOUMA, B/L 9553317. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS codes in the batch were 330290/330300/330499/330510 (cosmetics/perfumery), but the actual shipped goods are a diclofenac-based pain relief cream classified under HS 30049099 (medicament, not cosmetic). Per project rules this is NOT grounds for rejection — the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 30049099 (with 3302/3303/3304/3305 possible for other product lines, but not evidenced in the rows seen). Verdict on HS: accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the company both exports (to Senegal, UAE, USA) and imports (suppliers listed: ZHANGJIAGANG GUOCHAO GLASS PRODUCTS, JIANGSU MEITAR INTERNATIONAL TRADE — glass packaging/raw materials), i.e. it behaves as a manufacturer_trader. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free views; the '443 shipments' is a record count, not a value or tonnage, and must not be read as export volume. Domestic (India) supply: no traces found in accessible sources — status unknown, explicitly not 'conditionally accepted'. Data limitation: only 5 of the claimed 443 rows were visible, so the full date range and destination mix are unverified.
